native_policies: Existing vectors reinitialize fresh QuestTable count, not their length; source null or short reads stop as source_fault at the reached prefix.
Fresh vectors resize to zero slots before any allocation; unpublished failed factory allocations remain with the existing factory.
Quest C1, children ownership, AssignPyData and ReInit are mandatory providers of actual stable Quest objects. No fabricated empty Quest succeeds.
The source table base is captured before allocation for each new Quest; Character+5c is read after constructor and before children.
Source publication follows ReInit; D1 destroys and deallocates before clearing each pointer, then releases vector storage in reverse difficulty order.
Host vector representation and overflow/allocation guards replace undefined native memory access, not source error recovery. Failed closures must not be automatically retried.
New ownership fields are not connected to the existing PlayerSavegame projections or Android gameplay yet.
QuestSavegame +44[3] borrows the existing canonical Save quest-act arrays through explicit backing; blank Save initializes both arrays1. LNAM continues to use that same owner.
